items.title: Sustainable AI: Tools, frameworks and best practices in 2026
items.summary: Sustainability professionals are scrambling to understand how AI adoption will impact environmental goals.

items.title: Activist short-seller targets environmental failings
items.summary: A new activist investment fund that focuses exclusively on environmental issues has touted its first success after targeting a company that provides emissions-intensive electricity generation to data centers.

items.title: Scientists and industry clash over GHG Protocol forest carbon rules
items.summary: Another expert has stepped down from the standard-setting process following a dispute over how forests should be accounted for in corporate carbon footprints.

items.title: FOUR WEEKS to go until edie’s Sustainable Supply Chains Summit
items.summary: Join us on 17 September for a unique opportunity to gain expert-led insights through thought leadership and industry panels featuring top professionals in sustainability, supply chain and procurement.

items.title: Rosebank consultation concludes as groups warn PM against more drilling
items.summary: The public consultation period on the Rosebank oil and gas field project has now concluded, following the recent completion of a similar process for the Jackdaw gas field.

items.title: How ‘hidden’ water risks could create $6.4bn loss for agri-food giants
items.summary: The agrifood sector is underreporting the risks associated with water use across the value chain by up to 132 times what is being disclosed, with research stating that the financial impacts of water stress amount to $6.4bn for the sector’s largest firms.

items.title: ‘Carbon-neutral’ isn’t the goal, cutting emissions is
items.summary: Pip & Nut's supply chain and sustainability director, Adam Thompson, explains why the company's decision to step away from carbon neutrality is a good thing, enabling it to invest in supply chain decarbonisation, regenerative agriculture and climate resilience.

items.title: Business concern over El Niño risk hits multi-year high, analysis finds
items.summary: According to a review of major corporate filings and calls, El Niño has rapidly risen up the business agenda for companies across industries like food, chemicals and banking.

items.title: Analysis: The two largest reservoirs in the US have hit record-low levels
items.summary: The second-largest reservoir in the US reached a record-low water height on Saturday – just days after the country’s largest reservoir broke its own record.

items.title: Why land-use emissions have fallen by a third this century – in six charts
items.summary: Emissions from land-use change – including deforestation, loss of peatland and forest degradation – have been falling over the course of the 21st century.
